# HALFTONE

## Identity
- Project: HALFTONE
- Use: running club meeting place and neighbourhood cafe
- Wordmark: HALFTONE

- Counter sign: HALFTONE
- Meeting-zone sign: Run meeting

## Existing shell
| Item | Record | Treatment |

| Floor area | 120 m² | Retained |
| Clear height | 3.6 m | Retained |
| Footprint and opening dimensions | plan-with-cameras.png | Retained geometry |
| Glazed facades | North and west | Retained positions |
| Columns | Two; positions and sections in plan-with-cameras.png | Retained |
| Entrance and service door | Positions and dimensions in plan-with-cameras.png | Retained |

steps.userMessage:
HALFTONE | A running club meeting place and everyday cafe

We are fitting out the 120 m² corner unit in plan-with-cameras.png as our running club meeting place and neighbourhood cafe. Retain its north and west glazing, two columns, entrance and service door in their drawn positions, with the 3.6 m clear height. The plan supplies the footprint, opening dimensions and structural geometry. Coordinates use the southwest internal corner as the origin, x east, y north and z up, in metres. New lightweight partitions may organise storage and changing. Group new coffee equipment connections beside the service door. Preserve the attached HALFTONE wordmark and its dark green #2F4F3E. The cafe opens daily from 06:30 to 18:00. On Tuesday and Thursday, 12 runners gather from 06:45 to 07:00 and return from 07:30 to 08:00; eight cafe guests and two staff remain on site during the return peak. Provide a 12 m² meeting zone, 18 m² social rest zone seating all 12 runners, 16 m² cafe seating zone for eight guests, 12 m² storage and changing zone, and 14 m² service zone. Four cafe seats are quiet seats. Provide 12 lockers, two changing booths, a 1200 mm minimum clear main route and a 1500 mm turning circle at the entrance. Post-run rest centres on seated conversation and drinking water. Print "HALFTONE" at the counter and "Run meeting" at the meeting zone. Use matte terrazzo FL-01, clear-sealed ash WD-02 and wool-felt acoustic baffles AC-03 above the quiet seats, with separate ambient, task and accent lighting controls. Compare the return peak with weekday use from 14:00 to 15:00 by eight cafe guests and two staff. C1 looks northwest from [11.1, 0.9, 1.6] towards [4.4, 7.0, 1.55]; C2 looks east/south from [0.8, 8.5, 1.6] towards [8.6, 4.6, 1.55]. C3 is behind the selected counter, looking towards pickup and lockers at 1.6 m eye height; locate it on the developed plan.

Audience: running club members, everyday cafe guests and our operations team, for the layout decision and fit-out brief.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the operating brief, furniture dimensions and material records. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists each deliverable's proportion, format and stage. plan-with-cameras.png is the constraint drawing for the retained shell. activity-clearances.png is the constraint drawing for activity footprints and clearances. view-c1.png is an identity reference for the existing shell from C1. view-c2.png is an identity reference for the existing shell from C2. logo.png is the fixed identity reference for the wordmark. runners-after-run.png supplies a reference for post-run social behaviour. weekday-solo-visit.png supplies a reference for quiet individual use.

Deliverables:
1. Two written schedules: one functional and furniture schedule with zone areas, capacities, counts and dimensions; one materials and lighting schedule with codes, finishes, locations and controls
2. Three distinct layout direction boards, one each comparing runner access, cafe access and quiet seating
3. One selection record naming the chosen direction and its route, seating and service decisions
4. Three furnished plans: the developed layout, return-peak occupancy and weekday-afternoon occupancy, with zones, routes, furniture, service connections and clearances
5. Two section elevations with heights: counter and quiet seating; lockers and changing booths
6. Six occupied perspectives: C1, C2 and C3, each at the return peak and on a weekday afternoon
7. Three node detail sheets: combined storage and service; locker and changing construction; ordering, pickup and drinking-water arrangement
8. Two materials, furniture and lighting boards: the whole interior; quiet seating and social rest, with finish junctions and fixture locations
9. One 10-second circulation walkthrough of the selected interior, from entrance to meeting zone, lockers and pickup
10. One presentation document of at least 12 pages, reusing both schedules, three directions, the selection, all plans, sections, perspectives, node details and material boards

Acceptance:
- Establish both written schedules first, compare three directions, then name one in the selection record; identify it on all three furnished plans and the presentation's first page.
- Repeat the functional schedule's five zone names, areas of 12, 18, 16, 12 and 14 m², 12 lockers, two booths, four runner benches and eight cafe chairs on all three plans and in the presentation; repeat the materials schedule's FL-01, WD-02, AC-03 and LT-01 through LT-03 on both material boards, both sections and in the presentation.
- Retain the attached plan's 120 m² shell, 3.6 m clear height, two columns, glazing and openings across all plans, sections, six perspectives and walkthrough; dimension the plans' minimum 1200 mm main passage and 1500 mm entrance turning circle.
- Account for 12 runners, eight cafe guests and two staff on the peak plan, and eight cafe guests and two staff on the afternoon plan; place the same occupants consistently across each state's C1, C2 and C3 views, with four quiet seats and an ordering route outside the meeting footprint and quiet seating zone.
- Match all three node sheets to the plans and sections: 12 lockers with 300 × 450 × 450 mm clear interiors, two 1200 × 1500 mm clear booths, one ordering point, one pickup point and one drinking-water point. Match AC-03 above the quiet seats and the three separately controlled lighting layers across both schedules, both boards and relevant perspectives.
- Make HALFTONE in #2F4F3E and Run meeting legible in the C1 peak perspective and presentation; carry both signs through the 10-second walkthrough, and reuse all earlier deliverable categories across at least 12 presentation pages.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
